turns.doctor_question: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi. Well, I'm here because... I'm just having a really hard time at my job. I do bookkeeping, and I can't stop going back over the same spreadsheets and calculations again and again. 

I end up staying at work for hours after everyone else leaves. Even when I've already checked the numbers and I know they're right, I just... I feel like I have to do it one more time. Because if I don't, I get this overwhelming feeling that something really bad is going to happen, and it will be completely my fault. It's just getting really exhausting.

symptom_reasoning.S066: The patient describes repetitive, excessive checking of spreadsheets and calculations even after knowing they are correct, driven by the need to prevent a bad outcome, which meets the criteria for checking compulsions.

turns.doctor_question: When you recheck the spreadsheets, is it mainly to reduce a specific unwanted thought or fear that keeps intruding into your mind?
turns.patient_response:
Yeah, exactly. It's... well, even after I know the numbers match up perfectly, this thought just keeps jumping into my head. I'll start thinking that I missed one hidden mistake, like in payroll or the taxes. And then I worry that somebody's paycheck won't go through, or the firm is going to get into serious trouble. 

I try to push the thought away, I really do, but it just comes right back. It's like... I just can't even trust my own eyes anymore.

symptom_reasoning.S065: The patient describes intrusive, persistent thoughts and doubts about making mistakes that they cannot suppress, characteristic of obsessions.

turns.doctor_question: Do you recognize that repeatedly checking may be excessive or unreasonable, even though you feel unable to stop?
turns.patient_response:
I mean... I'm not really sure. When I'm at home, I guess I know that spending three extra hours on one spreadsheet sounds a bit crazy to other people. But when I'm actually sitting there looking at the screen, it doesn't feel unreasonable at all. It feels like I absolutely have to do it, or else something terrible is going to happen. 

So... I don't know. I see that it's a lot of time, but I just can't convince myself it's unnecessary when it's actually happening.
